instruction: Configure LibreOffice Impress to save presentations automatically every 1 minute for maximum data protection

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting auto-save interval to 1 minute for maximum protection. The evaluator checks the AutoSaveTimeIntervall property in registrymodifications.xcu to verify it's set to 1.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts the LibreOffice configuration file (registrymodifications.xcu)
Metric correctly parses XML and locates the AutoSaveTimeIntervall property at the correct path (/org.openoffice.Office.Common/Save/Document)
Comparison logic is semantically correct: checks if autosave interval equals 1 minute
Complete coverage: verifies the exact requirement from the instruction (1 minute auto-save)
Proper error handling for XML parse errors, missing files, and missing properties
No postconfig needed since evaluator reads persistent config file, not transient UI state
Expected value is semantically correct (1 minute matches instruction requirement)
